subject: Mplusautomation package just extract parital PSR(Potential scale Reduction) values out of the Mplus output using Tech8.

messages.author: dd68762ffa97bc2c
messages.subject: Mplusautomation package just extract parital PSR(Potential scale Reduction) values out of the Mplus output using Tech8.
parts:
Dr Michael,
Good afternoon. I used Mplusautomation package (version 0.7.3) to run Bayesian analysis and found it can extract the first part PSR values out of the Mplus output.
There are two parts PSR values: the first part is used for the computation of PPPP value and the second part is for the estimation of parameters.
What I need is the complete PSR values.

Attached is the mplus output and the r-command I used:
a<-readModels("sem5.bay2.out")
a$results$tech8$psr

Could you please help me to fix this problem? I appreciate your kindly help!

Best,

Fan Lin

messages.author: 644e1c01c3c42210
messages.subject: Re: Mplusautomation package just extract parital PSR(Potential scale Reduction) values out of the Mplus output using Tech8.
parts:
Hi there,

This problem was fixed in the development version of MplusAutomation, which can be installed here: https://github.com/michaelhallquist/MplusAutomation. I verified that the PSR extracts properly for your output using the development version. I hope to roll up a release of the package to CRAN in the coming weeks, but am currently overloaded with other demands.

Best,
Michael
